scope: Kubernetes v1.36 RestartAllContainers / PodRestartInPlace versus ClayVerse Tier-2 full Kata sandbox replacement

observed_problem.description: Kubernetes v1.36 documents RestartAllContainers as beta and enabled by default. It restarts all containers in place while preserving Pod UID, IP/network namespace, Pod sandbox, attached devices and volumes. That behavior can look like whole-Pod recovery but intentionally retains the sandbox identity, so it cannot satisfy ClayVerse Tier-2 full-appliance replacement.
observed_problem.strongest_counterhypothesis: Restarting every container and rerunning init containers might be sufficient to count as full appliance reconstruction.
observed_problem.falsifier: If Kubernetes preserves Pod UID and Pod sandbox across RestartAllContainers, then the old Kata sandbox/VM has not been proven terminal and a fresh guest-kernel boundary has not been created.
observed_problem.source_observation: Current Kubernetes documentation marks Restart All Containers as v1.36 beta/default-enabled and states that the in-place restart preserves Pod UID and Pod sandbox.

canonical_delta.contract_change: MICROVM_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT now explicitly classifies RestartAllContainers, PodRestartInPlace and equivalent in-place Pod reset as Tier-1/component evidence only and requires old sandbox destruction plus new Pod/sandbox identity for Tier-2.
canonical_delta.regression_change: Focused deterministic source fence requires the in-place-restart exclusion and the new-Pod/new-sandbox Tier-2 identity law.

concurrency_fence.action: Two attempts to amend the already-hot aggregate microVM test file were rejected by GitHub blob-SHA 409 fences after parallel main updates. The worker did not force or overwrite them; a separate focused regression file was created instead.

execution_state.note: The new source fence was not promoted to exact-runtime evidence because the retained Vercel path still fails closed before private Research/EntityOS source staging.

go_unusual_experiment.reason: No safely shared immutable request/turn id and only minute-precision trigger timing are exposed under the current atomic lease protocol. The Kubernetes source falsifier and deterministic regression are ordinary research/source work, not a consumed unusual experiment.

next_high_information_step: Provision approved host-side Vercel Preview GITHUB_READ_TOKEN without forwarding it into Sandbox; refresh/rebind then-current Research and retained lanes once; run exact isolated source/OCI closure; capture the accepted OCI digest; then execute that exact digest on the admitted Kata/equivalent target and prove actual Tier-2 deletion/replacement changes both Pod UID and sandbox/VM identity rather than using RestartAllContainers or another in-place reset.
